description: This file defines the PolicyAlgorithm interface, which extends the Enforcer interface. It provides default methods for checking permissions related to resources and building JSON views within a scenario setup, aimed at implementing policy enforcement algorithms.

classes.name: PolicyAlgorithm
classes.description: An interface for policy enforcing algorithms that provides default implementations of permission checking and JSON building methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the simple name of the implementing class.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnResource
methods.description: Checks if the scenario setup has unrestricted permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnResourceOrAnySubresource
methods.description: Checks if the scenario setup has partial permissions either on the resource or any subresource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view based on JSON fields and scenario setup authorization context.
